title: Model-Railway Timetable Simulator Task Board
originalRequest: Design and implement the core scheduling and dispatching modules for the model-railway timetable simulator to handle complex layouts.
latestMessage: Design and implement the core scheduling and dispatching modules for the model-railway timetable simulator to handle complex layouts.

steps.title: Define Dispatching Priority Logic for Single-Track Bottlenecks
steps.instruction: We need the product owner to clarify the priority hierarchy when a high-speed passenger train and a local freight train arrive at a single-track block simultaneously. Should the simulator strictly favor passenger timetables, or should it optimize for minimum total network delay? Please provide the decision matrix.
steps.acceptance: A documented decision matrix specifying train priority rules under conflict conditions.
